design: Three alternating paired repetitions on each of four fixed phensim HAPNEST workloads; n=10000 or 50000, m=12000; unstructured or confounded with two genotype PCs.
scope: Before/after mixmogam implementation comparison. Repetitions measure computational variability, not independent genetic realizations or calibration/power uncertainty.
precision: Original posterior formulas, variant order, block sizes, RNG seeds, priors, SLQ settings and convergence tolerances retained. Float64 residuals are refreshed before each storage-precision GEMM.
workspace_limits: 64 MiB explicit standardization scratch; 16 MiB explicit widening/squaring tiles in prediction, retrospective statistics and HE diagonals. These exclude final stored genotypes, result/work matrices, BLAS scratch and a minimum single row/variant/sample when it exceeds the nominal limit.
measurement: Whole-process wall time and kernel peak RSS; fit time separately. Both sources use fresh caches and a separate tiny warm-up. One BLAS/Numba thread, AC power, Low Power Mode off. Heavy validation jobs stopped during formal measurements.
diagnostic_profile: baseline_profile_n50000.txt is diagnostic only; concurrent validation may have affected its timing.
preserved_report: report/report_manifest.json and the academic PDF describe their historical pre-optimization source and resource tables; this archive supplies new optimization evidence.
